name: swiped.
summary: Weekly swipe file of top-performing design posts on X and LinkedIn, each with a prompt to write your own version.
description: A hand-curated swipe file of posts published by designers on X and LinkedIn, updated weekly with this-week and last-week picks plus an archive grouped by month. Each post links to the original and comes with an interview-style AI prompt that helps a designer write their own version of the post from their own experience; picks are grouped into categories like Opinion, Educational, Breakdown, Craft tip and Cheatsheet.
